configurePresets.name: macos-dev
configurePresets.description: The construction/development configuration on the dev platform. Diagnostics mechanism OFF (Release shape); the harness emitters are always compiled (they are product code armed by Config.harness).

configurePresets.name: macos-diag
configurePresets.description: Same as macos-dev with the core/diag mechanism compiled in (censuses, probe kit, recorders) and PS2R_SIMD=ON (the SIMD==scalar property test exercises the vector path here). Used for divergence escalation, never for equivalence hashes.

configurePresets.name: macos-dist
configurePresets.description: The shipped macOS artifact (Charter 2 C1): the macos-release shape with SDL2 built from the pinned release and linked STATICALLY (Homebrew's package is hidden: CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_SDL2), FFmpeg's three libraries from tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh (static, mpeg1/mpeg2 decoders + swscale only, --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree, found through CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH ahead of Homebrew's --enable-gpl build, which must never be shipped), GL = the system's OpenGL.framework, libc++ = the system's. dist/macos/ then has NO lib/: the binary + texts. ./build.sh on macOS uses this preset; the acceptance lane keeps macos-release with Homebrew's SDL2/FFmpeg.

configurePresets.name: linux-release
configurePresets.description: Linux x86-64 / aarch64 (glibc, Mesa GL through the core entry points, SDL2 found or -DPS2R_FETCH_SDL2=ON). The compiler is the environment's CC/CXX (GCC 12+ or Clang 15+, both -Werror clean); the -gcc / -clang variants pin one. Release shape, no diagnostics -- the shipped artifact and the hash-identity candidate.

configurePresets.name: linux-dev
configurePresets.description: Linux x86-64 / aarch64 (glibc, Mesa GL through the core entry points, SDL2 found or -DPS2R_FETCH_SDL2=ON). The compiler is the environment's CC/CXX (GCC 12+ or Clang 15+, both -Werror clean); the -gcc / -clang variants pin one. Debug shape, diagnostics OFF (the same shape as macos-dev).

configurePresets.name: linux-dist
configurePresets.description: The shipped Linux artifact (Charter 2 C1): the linux-release shape with Clang, SDL2 built from the pinned release and linked STATICALLY (the system package is hidden: CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_SDL2; the X11/Wayland/PulseAudio/ALSA back ends are dlopen'd at run time as in every SDL2 build from source), FFmpeg's three libraries from tools/ci/ffmpeg_static.sh (static, mpeg2video + swscale only, found through CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH), libstdc++/libgcc static. GL is the platform's libGL.so.1 (OpenGL_GL_PREFERENCE=LEGACY: the one library every Mesa or vendor install ships; the GLVND pair libOpenGL.so.0 + libGLX.so.0 is a separate package on Ubuntu, libopengl0, that libgl1 alone does not bring). ./build.sh on Linux uses this preset; the component lanes keep linux-release-{gcc,clang} with the distribution's SDL2/FFmpeg.

configurePresets.name: windows-dev
configurePresets.description: The Windows construction configuration: clang-cl (the clang semantics -fwrapv/-fno-strict-aliasing/-ffp-contract=off reach the recompiled TUs through /clang:), Ninja, SDL2 + FFmpeg from the vcpkg manifest (vcpkg.json; VCPKG_ROOT must point at a vcpkg checkout). The recompiler tool is OFF (its C dependency is regenerated on the dev host; the frozen output is committed). The compiler launcher tools/build/clang_cl_shim.py spells the tree's GNU-style per-target flags for this front end (-Wall -> /clang:-Wall, -ffp-contract=off -> /clang:..., see the script; ctest PlatformClangClShimContract).

configurePresets.name: windows-release
configurePresets.description: The Windows release configuration (Track B2): same compiler and dependencies as windows-dev, Release. build.ps1 drives it and stages dist/windows/. The compiler launcher tools/build/clang_cl_shim.py spells the tree's GNU-style per-target flags for this front end (-Wall -> /clang:-Wall, -ffp-contract=off -> /clang:..., see the script; ctest PlatformClangClShimContract).

configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-dev
configurePresets.displayName: Windows dev (Ninja, Debug, MSVC cl -- experimental)
configurePresets.description: cl.exe instead of clang-cl. The compiler shims (engine/platform/host) build with it, but cl has no -fwrapv: the recompiled TUs' signed-overflow wrap is relied upon, not guaranteed (games/<title>/recomp/CMakeLists.txt warns). Compile-check only; never a release. The compiler launcher tools/build/clang_cl_shim.py spells the tree's GNU-style per-target flags for this front end (-Wall -> /clang:-Wall, -ffp-contract=off -> /clang:..., see the script; ctest PlatformClangClShimContract). PS2R_BUILD_RECOMPILER stays OFF here: cl cannot compile tools/recompiler_v2/recompiler_tool/recompiler.cpp -- its long `else if (func.base_address == ...)` chain trips C1061 "blocks nested too deeply" at line ~5963 (MSVC caps nesting at 128; clang-cl has no such limit, so windows-dev and windows-release build it).
